rules.prompt: Follow PEP 8 guidelines. Format all Python code using the `black` code formatter with default settings. Lint the code using `ruff` to catch errors and style issues. All new functions and methods must include type hints for their arguments and return values, and be checked with `mypy`. All public modules, classes, and functions should have Google-style docstrings.

Format all code using Prettier with default settings. Lint the code with ESLint, adhering to the recommended rules for React (`eslint-plugin-react`) and TypeScript (`@typescript-eslint/recommended`). Prefer functional components with hooks over class-based components. All props and function return types should be explicitly defined.
Format all Markdown files to be consistent and readable. Use Prettier-compatible markdown styling. Ensure headings are sequential and lists are properly formatted.
Format all JSON files using Prettier with an indent of 2 spaces to ensure consistency.
